o: Describe the roles of a NIC, switch, router and WAP.
Distinguish local MAC-based forwarding from routing between networks.
Select correct equipment for a scenario.
c: A Network Interface Card (NIC) lets a computer connect to a network and transmit/receive data. Interfaces have MAC addresses.
A switch connects devices in one LAN and forwards local data using MAC addresses.
A router moves data between different networks, using destination IP addresses.
A WAP connects wireless devices to a network, normally through the existing wired LAN.

m.title: Send work to a printer
m.q: A student sends coursework to a printer on the same school LAN. Explain what the NIC and switch do. [4 marks]
st: The computer and printer are in the same LAN; the data must leave the computer.
A NIC provides network connectivity [1] and sends the data [1].
The switch connects LAN devices [1] and forwards the traffic using MAC addresses [1].
Two distinct devices with two accurate marking points each.

w: A pupil visits a website outside the school network. Explain the roles of the NIC and router. [4 marks]
The NIC connects the pupil's computer to the LAN [1] and sends/receives traffic [1]. The router forwards data between the LAN and external networks [1] using IP addresses [1].
Tablets must access a school's existing wired network. Explain why a WAP and switch are needed. [4 marks]
WAP lets tablets join wirelessly [1] by radio [1]. Switch links the WAP to the LAN [1] and forwards data to intended LAN devices [1].
Explain two differences between a router and a switch. [4 marks]
A switch handles traffic within a LAN [1] using MAC addresses [1]. A router forwards between networks [1] using IP addresses [1].

k.q: Simulate the decision to send traffic to a router when it is not local.
k.code:
local = 0
if local > 0 then
    print("Local network")
else
    print("Router needed")
endif
p: Add print("Packet checked") after the IF.
k.a:
With local = 0: Router needed. With 1: Local network.

Extended OCR ERL:
local = 1
if local > 0 then
    print("Local network")
else
    print("Router needed")
endif
print("Packet checked")

Output: Local network; Packet checked. This is a decision simulation.
